decisions.title: Rail Runner Operations and Maintenance Facility Conceptual Design Report
decisions.description: Develops the phased design for a modern Downtown Albuquerque Rail Runner maintenance campus, documenting existing deficiencies, operational needs, fleet projections, space requirements, site alternatives, repair and inspection functions, offices, storage, and conceptual drawings.
decisions.provenance_status: official Rio Metro facility project page and byte-identical official file recorded
processing_notes: Original authoritative 23-page PDF preserved without modification.
Exact size and SHA-256 recorded; complete text extraction, contents, findings, recommendations, and drawing index reviewed.
The report advances the 2016 assessment into an April 2022 phased conceptual design.

decisions.title: Rail Runner Operations and Maintenance Facility Assessment
decisions.description: Documents the original Downtown Albuquerque Rail Runner yard's undersized outdoor maintenance canopy, aging leased warehouse and offices, servicing inefficiencies, safety constraints, fleet needs, and recommendations that established the case for a modern operations facility.
decisions.provenance_status: official Rio Metro facility project page and byte-identical official file recorded
processing_notes: Original authoritative 6-page PDF preserved without modification.
Exact size and SHA-256 recorded; complete extracted text and all findings and recommendations reviewed.
The assessment is an April 2016 predecessor to the 2022 conceptual design report and current construction project.
